_about: The I-131 cover letter (src/fill/cover_letter.py): the firm's letterhead, signer and closing from the I-485 letter. The subject (which document), the address (USCIS 'Direct Filing Addresses for Form I-131', updated 08/11/2026: the non-family lockbox chart by state, or for advance parole filed after an I-485 the chart its receipt prefix decides) and the fee (Form G-1055 10/01/26: none for a person seeking or granted SIJ classification) come from src/travel.py. The attorney approves this file before volume use.

checklist.text: Cover letter: the attorney signs it.
Enclose the filing fee by the enclosed Form G-1450 (a U.S. card) or a Form G-1650 (a U.S. bank account), never a check: the amount in the cover letter. Not when the letter says no fee is due.
